correctness.rationale: The canonical stable-set hull is the m-cube fiber over the c-simplex, with c+2m irredundant facets A_i,B_j,C_j. Facet-pair codimension excludes B_j∩C_j and retains AA,AB,AC,BB,BC (different),CC. The exact Dirichlet integral ∫_{sum x<=1}(1-s)^q dx=q!/(c+q)! gives volume m!/(c+m)!, Euclidean Jacobians sqrt(c),sqrt(c+1),sqrt(2c+1), six individual ridge measures and their three universal N(N−1) normalized totals. Outward-normal products 0,−1/sqrt(c+1),c/(c+1) yield angles. Independently checked the symbolic specialization against broader multipartite formulas; the inspected geometry checker uses projected convex-hull volumes for c=1,2,3,4 small examples. No partial finite test is used to prove all integers.

originality.rationale: A complete published theorem for all complete multipartite stable-set polytopes (November 17, exact full RESULT inspected) implies the same split-graph ridge angle classes and normalized measures for every c>=2 by the parameter substitution k=c+1, (n_1,...,n_k)=(1,...,1,m), s=c, with normalization C=m!/(N−2)!=Vol_N N(N−1). Its right total ((k²−s)/2+(k−s)sqrt(k)) reduces to ((c²+c+1)/2+sqrt(c+1)), acute c sqrt(c), and obtuse sqrt(2c+1)/2; the interior angles supplement to precisely the split exterior ones. It also yields V_{N−2} by Steiner. k=2 (c=1) is not in the published k>=3 theorem but is a straightforward boundary case with little independently original general content. Both findings have November 17 publication dates, and order within the day is not established; the broader paper itself acknowledges split as previously derived. This is a present-coverage rejection, NOT an assertion of intra-day historical priority.
